verdict.rationale: The docs say the Skyvern SDK connects to a cloud Chromium instance over CDP and layers Playwright on top, adding drop-in AI commands that can fall back to selectors. This implies existing Playwright-style code can run against Skyvern's browsers. However, nothing documents attaching arbitrary existing Playwright or Puppeteer scripts to a Skyvern browser through an exposed CDP/WebSocket endpoint without going through the SDK. missing for 10: documented CDP endpoint/connect URL for external clients, Puppeteer support, migration guide for existing Playwright code, independent hands-on corroboration.
